common.soon: Coming soon on the App Store

add.title: Add a contact
add.description: Someone invited you to talk on FlickerTalk. Get the app, then paste their link in it to add them.
add.lead: Someone invited you to talk on FlickerTalk, a private messenger with no account and no phone number. To add them, paste their link in the app.
add.step1: If you already have FlickerTalk, skip this step.
add.step2: Go back to the message you received and copy the whole link, or copy the full address of this page.
add.step3: Open FlickerTalk, tap “{addContact.title}” (the QR code button at the top of {tabs.chats}) and choose “{addContact.scan}”. Then paste it into “{addContact.paste}” and tap “{addContact.add}”.

move.title: Move to a new phone
move.description: This link moves FlickerTalk from an old phone to a new one. Paste it in FlickerTalk on the old phone.
move.h1: Move FlickerTalk to a new phone
move.lead: This link comes from the code FlickerTalk shows on a new phone. Read on your old phone, it moves your identity, contacts and messages to the new one.
move.step1Title: On the new phone, get FlickerTalk.
move.step1: Open it and tap “{welcome.fromOld}” to show the code. If it already shows the code, skip this step.
move.step2Title: On the old phone, open FlickerTalk.
move.step3: Tap “{move.scan}” and scan it. Or copy this link, from where you got it or from the address of this page, paste it into “{move.paste}” and tap “{move.go}”. Once everything has moved, the old phone is erased.
